$comment: The product's name, in one place (docs/architecture/codebase-map.md#product-and-technical-names). `pnpm run brand:sync` writes every generated brand module from this file; `pnpm run rename-app -- "<New Name>"` edits it and runs the sync. `name` and `repository` are display values: everything that shows the name follows them. `identity` holds the values already written to narrators' machines and projects: they do NOT follow a rename, because the app finds each one again by its exact value, so changing one strands what is already on a machine or in a project.
name: Narration Studio
